title: Elon Musk signals end of Cybertruck production
excerpt: Elon Musk has indicated that Cybertruck production may be ending to make space for driverless Cybercabs.
body_html:
Elon Musk has suggested that the production of the Cybertruck is coming to an end. According to reports, this decision was made to free up manufacturing space for the company's Cybercabs.

The Cybercabs are described as autonomous taxis that operate without a driver. No further details regarding production timelines or vehicle phase-out schedules were provided in the announcement.
